stories.title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock
stories.brief: Countries from nearly 200 countries are in a deadlock to try and get a new global climate agreement.

stories.title: Deadly fire engulfs power station in southern Iraq
stories.brief: At least four people were killed and 30 injured after a fire tore through the Hartha power station complex.

stories.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
stories.brief: Pressures weighed on US markets, with the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average pushed into correction territory.

stories.title: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic’s second day of trading
stories.brief: On Friday, the Nasdaq Composite erased all its gains for 2026 and closed down 5% from its value on 1 January.

stories.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas
stories.brief: The US president provided little detail on the potential policy, saying others in his team were hearing about it for the first time.

stories.title: Mysterious Mercury is about to get a visitor - after spacecraft's eight-year epic voyage
stories.brief: The mission is set to give us our best ever view of Mercury - the closest planet to the Sun.

stories.title: Parliamentary affairs minister invites PTI to join NA electoral reforms committee
stories.brief: The government on Saturday invited the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) to join the National Assembly (NA) Electoral Reforms Committee (ERC), offering representation in proportion to the party’s strength in the lower house while rejecting its demand for equal representation.

stories.title: Videos, photos of 13-year-old domestic worker's torture at senior FIA official’s Islamabad residence emerge
stories.brief: Read: Court extends remand of two suspects in Fatima murder case Earlier, a post-mortem report prepared by the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS) revealed extensive injuries and signs of prolonged and brutal torture inflicted on the child.

stories.title: NIH issues nationwide advisories on flu, smog and vaccine-preventable diseases
stories.brief: The advisories, issued by the NIH’s Centre for Disease Control, cover the prevention and control of seasonal influenza for 2026-27, health risks and precautionary measures associated with smog, as well as vaccine-preventable disease control.

stories.title: Hafiz Naeem urges government to prioritise public relief in meeting with Naqvi
stories.brief: Later on October 27, Shehbaz also met Hafiz Naeem in Islamabad and agreed to form a six-member committee to finalise recommendations on expanding the existing petrol relief scheme and preparing proposals for a phased reduction in the petroleum levy.

stories.title: DPM Dar calls for new regional security framework to ensure lasting peace
stories.brief: Highlighting China's involvement in the peace efforts, Dar said Pakistan and China had proposed a five-point peace initiative that received substantial backing from major international actors, including the European Union and the United Kingdom.

stories.title: Iraq fire at Basra power station kills at least four, injures 30
stories.brief: At least 4 people were killed and 30 injured in a fire at a power station in southern Iraq on Saturday, with the toll expected to rise, security officials said.

stories.title: Anthropic mathematician claims he used Claude to prove 19th-century Riemann hypothesis
stories.brief: He says that Claude helped develop a solution to the problem during the course of about six weeks.
